claim_boundary: Independent training-seed replication for one previously official-gated ACWM-Phys cell. A 512-step screen is triage only; each seed requires the frozen official 50-step gate, and passing seeds may continue to the pre-registered 1k cap. This study does not establish cross-backbone transfer.

training_seed_contract.factorial_gate_design: 3 independent repair-training seeds x 3 shared evaluation seeds
training_seed_contract.promotion_rule: A seed is positive only after the frozen official 50-step PSNR/SSIM/MSE/masked-MSE gate passes. Report all seeds and all attempted checkpoints.

environment_records.mechanism_hypothesis: A bounded latent self-forcing objective reduces train-inference mismatch and the resulting long-horizon appearance drift in cloth rollouts.
